label: Ripple freezes 40.5M Ethereum RLUSD after Binance hack
note: At Ethereum block 26301251 (2026-10-29 22:00:59 UTC), Ripple paused address 0xE7024aB80143b1EF843EFE6a58368696Cb87958d on the RLUSD contract, locking 40,541,065 RLUSD linked to the October 29 Binance hack. Corroborated by TRM Labs attribution and public confirmation from Ripple's stablecoin leadership.
